cells.gaps: No delivery plan and no report against the 2008 policy has been found; its finance facts date from 2008, outside the 36 months, and the body is read from the 2025 review notice (LSO-009), which names the ministry and the regulator as responsible for the 2008 policy. Nothing is dated inside the twelve months to the as-at. The ICT Policy 2021 is held only as a draft (2022) and the 2025 review of the 2008 policy only as a tender, so neither is adopted; the ICT Policy 2005 was adopted earlier and its period ended in 2020.
cells.note: Lesotho Communications Policy 2008: the newest adopted sector policy, with its text public and no end year, so stage 3. An open policy stops at stage 3, and no delivery plan or results report has been found for it.
